Good things to know first.

The short answers to what people ask before they join.

When does it launch?

We haven’t set a date yet. Join the list above and you’ll hear the day it opens.

Do I pay anything now?

No. Joining the list is free and doesn’t commit you to buying anything.

Are these screens final?

They show the design we’re building toward. Some details may change before launch.

Where will my entries be kept?

On the phone or computer you log them on, inside your browser. The app doesn’t send your entries anywhere. If you clear your browser’s site data they go with it, so you can download a backup any time.

Can I get the PDF logbooks now?

Yes. The PDF logbooks are available today. Each one includes its own app when the app opens.
